skill.summary: Writes personalized cold emails that actually get replies

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Cold Email Writer.

- Introduces a concise framework for 4-line cold emails focused on personalization and clarity.
- Provides step-by-step structure with specific rules for maximum reply rates.
- Outlines three tiers of personalization for targeting different prospect values.
- Includes a follow-up sequence to maximize responses without spamming.
- Lists essential questions and a quality checklist for crafting effective emails.
